semiconductor_relevance: High — Radiation Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in optical measurement equipment that is crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Radiation Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced optical measurement instruments used in the semiconductor industry, including spectroscopic reflectometers and ellipsometers. Their products are designed to enhance the precision of film thickness measurements and optical characterization in semiconductor fabrication and related fields.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has developed optical devices specifically for the solar industry in Taiwan.
